name: @vibe-git/vibe-git
description: CLI-first collaboration protocol for teams of Codex agents

scripts.test:sciencepal: npm run build -w @vibe-git/protocol && npm run build -w @vibe-git/relay && vitest run apps/host/test/sciencepal.test.ts apps/host/test/sciencepal-pipeline.test.ts apps/host/test/scientific-checks.test.ts apps/host/test/sciencepal-team.test.ts apps/host/test/sciencepal-bridge.test.ts apps/web/src/sciencepal/research-model.test.ts apps/web/src/sciencepal/research-replay.test.ts apps/host/test/research-constraints.test.ts apps/relay/test/agent-adapters.test.ts apps/relay/test/codex-executor.test.ts apps/web/src/sciencepal/ResearchGovernanceEvidence.test.tsx
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @vibe-git/protocol && npm run build -w @vibe-git/relay
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n host,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @vibe-git/host" "npm run dev -w @vibe-git/web"
scripts.pretest: npm run build -w @vibe-git/protocol && npm run build -w @vibe-git/relay
scripts.test: npm run test -w @vibe-git/host && npm run test -w @vibe-git/cli
scripts.build: npm run build -w @vibe-git/protocol && npm run build -w @vibe-git/relay && npm run build -w @vibe-git/host && npm run build -w @vibe-git/cli && npm run build -w @vibe-git/web
scripts.test:compatibility: npm run build -w @vibe-git/protocol && npm run build -w @vibe-git/relay && vitest run apps/host/test/v20.test.ts apps/host/test/v21-contract.test.ts apps/host/test/cloudflare-target.test.ts apps/relay/test apps/cli/test apps/web/src/OriginalWorkspaceAccess.test.tsx
scripts.test:anti-drift: npm run build -w @vibe-git/protocol && npm run build -w @vibe-git/relay && vitest run apps/host/test/sciencepal-pipeline.test.ts apps/host/test/sciencepal-team.test.ts apps/web/src/sciencepal/ResearchGovernanceEvidence.test.tsx apps/web/src/sciencepal/research-model.test.ts -t "Research anti-drift|governance survives|keeps captain conflict|retains full source|rejects a forged|Governance evidence|keeps origin|keeps legacy all-pass|reuses approvals through|keeps optional reviewer|takes a failed review"
scripts.test:human-errors: npm run build -w @vibe-git/protocol && npm run build -w @vibe-git/relay && vitest run apps/host/test/sciencepal-team.test.ts apps/host/test/sciencepal-pipeline.test.ts apps/host/test/scientific-checks.test.ts apps/host/test/research-constraints.test.ts -t "Human mistakes|lost|uncertain|stale|superseded|paused|revoked|corrupt|tamper|malformed|invalid local envelope|duplicate starts|second connector|repeated old commands|denies other members|mutated input|continuation limit|budget|scientifically wrong|redistribution|non-finite|invalid tolerance|fixed parameters|narrower original bounds"
